paite: Huan kum nih vingveng nung in hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in mang anei a; ngai in, lui gei ah ana dingh hi.
english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

paite: Ngai in, bawngpi sagih hoih taktak, thau taktak ngen tui a kipan ahong pawtkhetou ua, loupa nou lak ah ahong gamta uhi.
english: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

paite: Ngai in, bawngpi dang sagih kil theuthou, gawng gemgom ahong pawtkhe nawn ua, bawngpi dangte kiang, lui gei ah adingh uhi.
english: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

paite: Huan bawngpi kil theuthoute'n bawngpi hoih taktak, thau taktakte anegai maimah uhi.
heading: Joseph In Pharaoh Mang Hilhchian
english: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh akhanglou a, a-ihmu nawn a, mang anei nawn hi. Ngai in, buh kung khat ah avui sagih lian pipi, hoih liahluah ahong omkhia hi.
english: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

paite: Ngai in, huai nung in vui sagih ngat giuhgeuh suahlam huih in anuai eksa nung ahong omkhe nawn hi.
english: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

paite: Avui ngat giuhgeuhte'n avui sagih lian pipi, hoih liahluahte avalh khin maimah uhi. Huchi in Pharaoh akhanglou a; ngai in, mang ana hi.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

paite: Azingsang in hichi ahong hi a, alungsim abuai mahmah a; mi asawl a, Aigupta gam a mitkhialdawi siam tengteng leh mipil tengteng asamkhawm hi. Pharaoh in amang amau ana hilh a; himahleh Pharaoh mangte hilhchian thei kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

paite: Huchih lai in uain pia heutupen in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Tuni in ka hihkhelh ka theikhia hi.
english: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

paite: Khatvei asikhate tung ah Pharaoh aheh a, huchi in vengmi pawl heutu inn ah kei leh tanghou bawl heutupen ahon tangsak hi.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

paite: Kei leh ama'n zan khat mang ka nei ua, akhiakna tuam tuak ahi ka mat uh.
english: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

paite: Huai ah ka kiang uah vengmi pawl heutu sikha, Hebru mi, tangval khat a-om a; amah ka hilh ua, ama'n ka mangte uh ahilhchian hi. Ka mang uh toh kituak in ahon hilhchetsak hi.
english: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kei ka nasep mah ahon semsak nawn a, amah akhailumta hi,” achi hi.
english: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph asamsak pah a, kintak in suangkul a kipan apikheta uhi. Amah akimet ngil a, apuansilh akhek a, Pharaoh kiang ah ava lut hi.
english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph kiang ah, "Mang ka nei a, ahilhchian thei kuamah a-om kei uh. Nang mang thu na zak chiang in na hilhchian thei chih na tungtangmi gen ka na za hi,” achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

paite: Joseph in Pharaoh adawng a, "Huai ahihleh kei a om ahi kei hi. Pathian in lungkimhuaitak in Pharaoh adawng zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph kiang ah, "Ka mang in, ngai in, lui gei ah ka na dingh hi.
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

paite: Ngai in, bawngpi sagih hoih taktak, thau taktak ngen tui a kipan ahong pawtkhetou ua, loupa nou lak ah ahong gamta uhi.
english: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

paite: Bawngpi dang sagih gina lou leh deihhuai lou leh gawng siatsuat, huchibang tel a hoih lou Aigupta gam tengteng a leng ka muh ngei louh, anung uah ahong pawtkhetou nawn uhi.
english: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

paite: Bawngpi gawng siatsuat deihhuai lou pipite'n bawngpi sagih thau taktak hong pawt masate anegai maimah uhi.
english: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

paite: Anekgaih khit nung un leng, ane uh chih akithei tuan kei hi. Atung lai mah bang in deihhuai loutak in a-om lailai uhi. Huchi in ka khanglouta hi.
english: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

paite: Ka mang in, ngai in, buh kung khat ah vui sagih lian pipi, hoih pipi ahong vuikhia hi.
english: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

paite: Ngai in, huai nung in vui sagih vuai ningniang, neu chikchik, suahlam huih in anuai hong vuikhe nawn hi.
english: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

paite: Avui ngat ngiungeute'n avui sagih hoih taktakte avalh khit maimah uh ka mu hi. Mitkhialdawi siamte ka hilh a, himahleh hon hilhchian thei kuamah a-om kei uh," chi in agen hi.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

paite: Joseph in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Pharoah mang khat ahi a, Pathian in hih ding a akisak Pharaoh theisak ahi.
english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

paite: Bawng sagih hoih taktakte kum sagih ahi ua; vui sagih hoih taktakte leng kum sagih mah ahi uh. Huai mang khat ahi.
english: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

paite: Anung ua bawng sagih tek taktak, deihhuai lou taktak hong pawtkhetoute kum sagih ahi ua, vui sagih ahawm ngen suahlam huih nuaite toh; huaite kial kum, kum sagih ding ahi.
english: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

paite: Hiai ahi Pharaoh kiang a ka gen. Pathian in hih ding a akisak Pharaoh kiang a theisak ahi.
english: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

paite: Ngai in, Aigupta gamsung pumpi ah niang-le-tai a om kum, kum sagih ahong tung ding.
english: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

paite: Huai nung in kial kum, kum sagih ahong om nawn ding. Huchi in Aigupta gam ah niang-le-tai a omna mangngilh vek ahita ding. Kial in gam anegawp vek ding hi.
english: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

paite: Niang leh tai kum hon zui kial pen anasat mahmah ding ziak in mite'n hiai gam hauhsak lai hun athei nawnta kei ding uh.
english: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

paite: Pharaoh mang nihvei aneih tuansakna ahihleh hiai ziak ahi. Thilhih ding Pathian in ahihkip a, Pathian in atungsak pah ding hi.
english: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

paite: "Tu in Pharaoh in mi khat, teitak leh piltak zongkhia henla, Aigupta gam tung ah heutu in omsak hen.
english: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

paite: Pharaoh in hiai hih hen. Gam tung ah heutute sep henla, niang-le-tai a om kum, kum sagih sung Aigupta gam buh mun nga a khen mun khat zel kaikhawm hen.
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

paite: Amau huai kum hoih kum hong tung ding a buh tengteng kaikhawm in Pharaoh nuai a om ding in khuate ah tunung a nek ding in buh sungkhawm henla, kholkhawm hen.
english: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

paite: Kial ziak a gam amanlouhna ding in, buh kial kum, kum sagih Aigupta gam a hong tun hun a ding in hiai gam a ding a kiginkholhna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

paite: Pharaoh leh asikha tengteng in hiai thusawm hoih asaklamtak uh ahi.
heading: Aigupta Ukpa A Joseph Bawl Ahi
english: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

paite: Pharaoh in asikhate kiang ah, "Hichibang Pathian kha omna mi i muzou ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

paite: Pharaoh mah in Joseph kiang ah, "Pathian in hiai tengteng hon theihsak ziak in, nang bang a tei leh pil himhim a-om kei uh.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

paite: Nang ka inkote tung ah heutu in na om ding a, ka khua-le-tui tengteng na thu bang zel in a-om ding uh. Laltutphah a tut thu ah kia nang sang in ka lianzaw ding," achi hi.
english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

paite: Pharaoh mah in Joseph kiang ah, "En in, Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi,” achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

paite: Pharaoh in akhut a kipan aminsawnna zungbuh atolkhia a, Joseph khut ah abunsak a, puanmalngat a kibawl puansilhte asilhsak a, angawng ah dangka-eng khainiang a-oksak lai hi.
english: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

paite: Akangtalai neih nihna ah atuangsak a, "Ama ah khukdin un," chi in mi akikousak hi. Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah heutu in abawlta hi.
english: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph kiang ah, "Kei Pharaoh ka hi, na thu lou in Aigupta gamsung pumpi ah kuamah in akhut uh hiam, akhe uh hiam alik kei ding," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph min Zaphnath-Paneah asa a; azi ding in On kho siampu Potiphera tanu Asenath apia hi. Joseph apawt a, Aigupta gamsung pumpi asiksuak hi.
english: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh ma a Joseph adin lai in kum sawmthum a upa ahi. Pharaoh a kipan Joseph apawt a, Aigupta gamsung pumpi asiksuak hi.
english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

paite: Hauh kum, kum sagih sung, lei in buh tampi atungsak hi.
english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

paite: Aigupta gam ah hauh kum, kum sagih ahong tung a, buh tengteng adongkhawm a, huai buhte khuate ah asungkhawmta hi. Akim a om kho chih lou a buhte asungkhawm chiat hi.
english: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

paite: Joseph in buh tampi, tuipi piaunel zah bang in asungkhawm venvon a, asim leng atawp hial hi; sim zoh vual louh ahih tak ziak in.
english: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

paite: Kial ahong tun ma in Joseph in tapa nih anei a, huaite On kho siampu Potiphera tanu Asenath in aneihsakte ahi uh.
english: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

paite: Joseph in atapa masa min Manasseh asa a, "Pathian in ka sepgimna leh ka pa insung mite tengteng ahon mangngilhsakta," achi hi.
english: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

paite: Atapa nihna min Ephraim asa a, “Pathian in ka gimthuakna gam ah chi ahon suangsakta,” achi hi.
english: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

paite: Hauh kum, kum sagih Aigupta gam a hong tung abeita hi.
english: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

paite: Huan kial kum, kum sagih ding, Joseph gen bang in ahong tung panta hi. Gam chih ah kial ahong keta a; Aigupta gamsung teng ah bel nek ding a-om hi.
english: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

paite: Aigupta gam a mi tengteng akialtak un, Pharaoh kiang ah nek ding ngen in akikou uhi. Pharaoh in Aigupta mite kiang ah, "Joseph kiang ah hoh unla; na kiang ua agen peuhmah hih un," achi hi.
english: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

paite: Leitung pumpi ah kial aketa hi. Joseph in sunkhawmna buh innte ahong a, Aigupta gam ah leng kial anak kiak mahmah hi.
english: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

paite: Leitung pumpi a kial anak kiak luat ziak in gam chih a mite buh lei ding in Aigupta gam a Joseph kiang ah ahong zel uhi.
english: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
